How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three Years Graduate degree in Life Sciences with three years of experience, or a First Class M.Sc. in Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Project Assistant position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for PGIMER Senior Project Assistant jobs?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their complete bio-data and required documents via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is PGIMER located?
faq.answer: PGIMER is located in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q10. What is the interview date for the Senior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Senior Project Assistant post is scheduled to be held on 3rd September 2026.
